attribution: receipt-envelope-profile v0.1 R2 — ordering counter-proof, added after a planted defect survived the first ten vectors (2026-08-30)
rationale: A refusal says 'I cannot judge this'. A broken signature IS judgeable, so a bundle that fails verification must be `invalid` even though its payload names a schema this verifier does not know. Reporting `refused_unknown_schema` here would let a forger buy silence by renaming the schema field. This case exists because a planted defect removing the authenticity-first ordering left all ten other vectors green — the ordering was documented and unproven.
